mapper.select: /* TbmSessionShareMapper.selectSessionOwner */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.CMPNY_CD AS hostCmpnyCd , S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , S.DEL_YN AS delYn FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} LIMIT 1

/* TbmSessionShareMapper.countReachable */ WITH RECURSIVE UPCHAIN AS ( SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS SESSION_CD , S.HOST_CMPNY_CD AS HOST_CMPNY_CD , S.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD AS DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD , 1 AS DEPTH FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE S WHERE S.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT P.SESSION_CD , P.HOST_CMPNY_CD , P.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD , U.DEPTH + 1 FROM UPCHAIN U INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE P ON ( P.SESSION_CD = U.SESSION_CD AND P.SHARE_CMPNY_CD = U.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' ) WHERE U.DEPTH < 20 AND U.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD <> U.HOST_CMPNY_CD ) SELECT COUNT(1) FROM UPCHAIN WHERE DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD = HOST_CMPNY_CD

/* TbmSessionShareMapper.selectShareChain */ WITH RECURSIVE CHAIN AS ( SELECT S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD AS SHARE_CMPNY_CD , S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD AS TIER1_CMPNY_CD , 1 AS DEPTH FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE S WHERE S.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD = #{hostCmpnyCd} UNION ALL SELECT S2.SHARE_CMPNY_CD , C.TIER1_CMPNY_CD , C.DEPTH + 1 FROM CHAIN C INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE S2 ON ( S2.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND S2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S2.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD = C.SHARE_CMPNY_CD ) WHERE C.DEPTH < 20 ) SELECT C.SHARE_CMPNY_CD AS shareCmpnyCd , C.TIER1_CMPNY_CD AS tier1CmpnyCd , IFNULL(T.CMPNY_NM, '') AS tier1CmpnyNm , C.DEPTH AS depth FROM CHAIN C LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CMPNY T ON ( T.CMPNY_CD = C.TIER1_CMPNY_CD ) ORDER BY C.DEPTH, C.SHARE_CMPNY_CD

/* TbmSessionShareMapper.selectShareRows */ SELECT S.SHARE_ID AS shareId , S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , IFNULL(C.CMPNY_NM, '') AS cmpnyNm , DATE_FORMAT(S.DESIGNATED_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS designatedDtime , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE S2 WHERE S2.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND S2.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD = S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD AND S2.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS subCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE S LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CMPNY C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD ) WHERE S.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND S.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD = #{designatedByCmpnyCd} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY S.DESIGNATED_DTIME, S.SHARE_ID

/* TbmSessionShareMapper.selectDesignateCandidates */ SELECT X.cmpnyCd AS cmpnyCd , IFNULL(C.CMPNY_NM, '') AS cmpnyNm FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{actorCmpnyCd} THEN R.TGT_CMPNY_CD ELSE R.REQ_CMPNY_CD END AS cmpnyCd FROM TB_CMPNY_RELATION R WHERE R.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND (R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{actorCmpnyCd} OR R.TGT_CMPNY_CD = #{actorCmpnyCd}) ) X LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CMPNY C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = X.cmpnyCd ) WHERE X.cmpnyCd <> #{hostCmpnyCd} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE S WHERE S.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD = X.cmpnyCd AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY cmpnyNm ASC

/* TbmSessionShareMapper.countActiveRelation */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_CMPNY_RELATION R WHERE R.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( (R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdA} AND R.TGT_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdB}) OR (R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdB} AND R.TGT_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdA}) )

/* TbmSessionShareMapper.selectDescendantCmpnyCds */ WITH RECURSIVE DESC_CHAIN AS ( SELECT S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD AS CMPNY_CD , 1 AS DEPTH FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE S WHERE S.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD = #{rootCmpnyCd} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT S2.SHARE_CMPNY_CD , D.DEPTH + 1 FROM DESC_CHAIN D INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE S2 ON ( S2.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND S2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S2.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD ) WHERE D.DEPTH < 20 ) SELECT DISTINCT CMPNY_CD FROM DESC_CHAIN

/* TbmSessionShareMapper.selectSharesByCmpnyPair */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD AS shareCmpnyCd FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE S WHERE S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( (S.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdA} AND S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdB}) OR (S.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdB} AND S.SHARE_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdA}) ) ORDER BY S.SESSION_CD, S.SHARE_ID
